with open\('sample_experiment.md', 'r', encoding='utf-8'\) as f:
    lines = f.readlines\(\)

def extract\(start, fname\):
    import os
    i = start
    if lines[i+1].strip\(\).startswith\('\\`\\`\\`'\):
        content_start = i + 2
    else:
        print\(f'No fence at {i+1}: {lines[i+1]!r}'\)
        return
    j = content_start
    while j < len\(lines\):
        if lines[j].strip\(\) == '\\`\\`\\`':
            break
        j += 1
    body = ''.join\(lines[content_start:j]\)
    dirpath = os.path.dirname\(fname\)
    if dirpath:
        os.makedirs\(dirpath, exist_ok=True\)
    with open\(fname, 'w', encoding='utf-8'\) as f:
        f.write\(body\)
    print\(f'Written: {fname} \({j-content_start} lines\)'\)

extract\(2544, 'config/config.py'\)
" 2>&1)
